summary: Pettai is a panchayat village and revenue village in the Pondicherry Union Territory of India. It falls under the Thirunallar Taluk (formerly Thirunallar Commune Panchayat) of Karaikal District. The village lies on the banks of the Arasalar River, west of Karaikal town and south of Thirunallar.
one_line: Pettai is a panchayat and revenue village in Karaikal District, Pondicherry Union Territory, on the Arasalar River.
key_facts: Pettai is a panchayat village and revenue village in Pondicherry Union Territory, India.
Pettai is administratively under the Thirunallar Taluk of Karaikal District, Pondicherry Union Territory.
The Thirunallar Taluk was formerly known as Thirunallar Commune Panchayat.
Pettai is situated on the banks of the Arasalar River.
Pettai is located to the west of Karaikal town.
Pettai is located south of Thirunallar.
